sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) FROM orders o JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.date >= '2026-05-31 00:00:00' AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00';

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) FROM orders o JOIN product p ON o.product_id = p.product_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.birth_date > '2000-09-24' AND c.birth_date <= '2001-09-24';
